case.name: Page Layout Rentals
case.description: Sets the latest page layouts as active for the rental event, location, resource, and rental-resource objects, confirms the 'Store' location type exists, and adds a Rentals status Path.

steps.name: Assign the most-recent Veevart layout as the active Rental Event/Group page layout
steps.description: PART A, Rental Event/Group. T2 mode:'assign'. Re-points the Auctifera__Rental_Event__c object's page-layout assignment to 'Auctifera__Rental_Event__c-vnfp__VNFP Rental Event Layout - V12 - April 2026' (the most-recent of the org's Rental Event layouts) across all discovered profiles (profiles omitted → handler auto-discovers). Layout fullName carries the vnfp__ managed-package namespace — confirmed by a named-member `sf project retrieve` that succeeds with this exact fullName, NOT the namespace-stripped name `sf org list metadata` reports. No record-type scoping (object has no record types). Verified by reading each Profile back (rules §6).

inputPayload.layout: Auctifera__Rental_Event__c-vnfp__VNFP Rental Event Layout - V12 - April 2026

steps.name: Assert the 'Store' value exists on the Display/Storage Location Type field
steps.description: PART B. CSV mid-section: add the value 'Store' to the Display/Storage Location object's 'Type' field (Auctifera__Type__c — a RESTRICTED LOCAL picklist per `sf sobject describe`). The org already has 'Store' on the value set (describe values: Room, Location within a room, Storage, Area, Store), so this runs as ensureOnly (READ-ONLY ASSERTION): it verifies 'Store' is present and writes nothing. Auctifera__Type__c is a managed-package field, and ensureOnly avoids any managed-field write while still attesting the CSV outcome ('Check that the new value is created'). If a future org lacks the value, ensureOnly yields success=false and flags the operator rather than silently mutating a managed field.

steps.name: Create and activate the Rentals Path (manual)
steps.description: PART C — MANUAL. CSV final section: create a Path on the Rental Event/Group object. Path is a PathAssistant metadata type the T2/T3 page-layout and metadata tools do NOT cover, so do it by hand: 1) Setup > Quick Find 'Path Settings' > open Path Settings. 2) Click 'New Path'. 3) Fill in — Path Name: 'Rental Path'; API Reference Name: 'Rental_Path'; Object: 'Rental/Event Group' (Auctifera__Rental_Event__c); Record Type: leave the system default, DON'T TOUCH; Picklist: 'Status'. 4) Click 'Next'. 5) (Optional guidance per step — leave as-is) click 'Next'. 6) Click 'Activate your path'. 7) Click 'Finish'. Mark this step done once the 'Rental Path' shows as Active in Path Settings for the Rental Event/Group object.

template.name: IC 8.01: Page Layout Rentals
template.description: Single-case template for implementation case 8.01 (HYBRID: four AUTOMATED T2 mode:'assign' steps that make the most-recent Veevart layout active for the Rental Event/Group, Display/Storage Location, Resource/Service and Rental Resource objects across all discovered profiles, verified by Profile read-back; one AUTOMATED T3 picklistValues ensureOnly assertion that 'Store' exists on the Display/Storage Location Type field; one MANUAL handoff to create and activate the 'Rental Path' PathAssistant). Standalone; in the real DAG this would dependsOn ic-3-01-install-auctifera (which creates the Auctifera rental objects/layouts).
